protocol: Continuous training to the largest budget, official linear LR schedule over that full horizon; each earlier checkpoint is a point on that same run. SAME_STEP corrected episode handling, timeout bootstrap, reset histories, fresh splines and configured action noise.

execution.controlled_stop: Both workers stopped only after all 1.5M/5M/15M checkpoint validations and final training_seconds were persisted. Final evaluations run once after merging the two seeds.

selected.rule: Maximum mean return on 128 fixed validation splines, before running holdout.

invalid_stress_before_inertia_fix.reason: Original racing inertia randomizer perturbed all nine matrix entries independently, producing asymmetric inertia tensors.

inertia_randomization_regression.distribution: Independent uniform [-1e-6, 1e-6] noise on three principal moments; no rejection or clipping.
